# meltcloud_machine (Data Source)

[Machines](https://docs.meltcloud.io/concepts/machines) are bare-metal or virtualized computers designated as worker nodes for the Kubernetes control planes provided by the [Nest](https://docs.meltcloud.io/concepts/nest) appliance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# get machine by ID
data "meltcloud_machine" "example_id" {
  id = 42
}

# get machine by UUID
data "meltcloud_machine" "example_uuid" {
  uuid = "0442228d-023e-42ab-af34-da267d3e9c37"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Internal ID of the Machine in meltcloud
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the Machine

### Read-Only

- `labels` (Map of String) Kubernetes labels to set on the Machine's node, for example `{ "node-role.example.com/storage" = "true" }`
- `machine_pool_id` (Number) ID of the associated machine pool
- `name` (String) Name of the Machine
- `status` (String) Status of the Machine
- `zone_id` (Number) ID of the [Zone](https://docs.meltcloud.io/concepts/regions-and-zones) the Machine is in. Sets the Kubernetes labels `topology.kubernetes.io/region` and `topology.kubernetes.io/zone` on the Machine
